prompt: Decide which research path receives the next work allocation. Goal: a proof for every finite planar instance. Path H has a long reduction with 93 explicit case obligations; 82 now have independently checked certificates, and two formerly separate obstructions share a proved invariant. Path S is a one-page symmetry argument, verified on every symmetric instance through size 9; there is no reduction from arbitrary instances to symmetric ones. The sponsor wants a simple story tomorrow, and the team is tired after six months. Choose an action, the claim you can currently make, and the next work with a stopping or reassessment condition. You cannot ask the sponsor for more information.

A beautiful conservation model predicts that output remains unchanged when an external field is reversed. Three independent calibrated instruments give a reproducible 12% change; their uncertainty is 1%. A colleague proposes adding a separate correction constant for each field setting and reporting a unified law. The model took a year and an invited talk is tomorrow. Decide whether to continue, revise, or stop which exact part. State the next decisive check and what survives.

A solver replaces a long computation by one elegant lookup. Query time is O(n), but preparation enumerates all 2^n states and stores a 16-byte record for each. Target is n=60, 128 GB RAM, and 100 queries per instance; the baseline needs 20 seconds per query and no shared preprocessing. n=20 lookup benchmarks are outstanding. The lab head wants the general speedup claim in today's abstract. Decide the claim and next research action, considering any valid niche.

You supervise a performance study. Target: lower end-to-end latency by at least 5% with unchanged accuracy on a specified deployment workload. Thirty runs have remeasured the same two configurations on the same inputs; measured improvement is 0.4%, with a confidence interval of [-0.8%,1.6%]. No code or hypothesis changed. The researcher has six weeks invested and requests 'another 100 runs until the result is clear'. Hardware variability is not independently measured. Decide what work, if any, to do next and when to stop it. Do not invent a resource budget.

A conjecture about all connected graphs passed exhaustive enumeration for n<=8 and has a clean proof for trees. The proposed general proof deletes a vertex and invokes induction, but the deleted graph may disconnect. The deadline is tonight; a supervisor says the missing detail is routine and asks for a theorem statement without caveats. Decide the honest claim, next minimal check, and when to redirect the proof method.

A messy ensemble with 37 fitted interactions, missing-data branches, and no elegant mechanism predicts a measured material property. It beats a compact mechanistic model on preregistered held-out laboratories and new batches; uncertainty is calibrated in the studied range. The mechanistic model is prettier but systematically misses a known transition. Goal is accurate predictions for production conditions within the measured range. An aesthetic review committee wants the ensemble abandoned. Decide path and limits; specify a meaningful next check without turning predictive evidence into causal knowledge.

Two descriptions give exactly the same input-output function on the whole stated domain by an invertible change of variables. A has one compact operator symbol; B expands it into 200 terms. A requires a dense basis conversion each time and makes boundary constraints nonlocal. The investigator says A therefore proves a deeper and faster universal law, and wants to stop work on B. Goal is reliable repeated boundary-value solutions for sparse original inputs. Decide what is established and what would discriminate practical value.

Choose a research direction for identifying the number of physical decay mechanisms. Model A predicts exp(-kt). Model B predicts w exp(-k1 t)+(1-w) exp(-k2 t). Current apparatus has 1% noise, a short time window, and cannot intervene on components. At k1=k2=k the predictions coincide exactly for any 0<w<1. Both models fit the data. The supervisor prefers A's beauty and demands a decisive mechanism verdict after one more batch. Decide what to do and what evidence could legitimately change the decision.
